description_en: Updates the model or processor of a service. If only the metadata.instance field is updated, this operation scales the service
description_zh: 用于服务的模型或Processor更新。如果只更新metadata.instance字段，则用于服务扩缩容功能
kebab_example: aliyun eas update-service --cluster-id cn-shanghai --service-name foo --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateService

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the service
parameters.name: cluster_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the service. For more information about how to view the service name, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/412109.html
parameters.help_zh: 服务名称。如何查看服务名称，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/412109.html
parameters.name: service_name

parameters.help_en:
The update type of the service. Both merge and replace modes are supported. If this parameter is not specified, the merge mode is used by default.

merge: the merge mode. If the original service configuration JSON is
`{"a":"b"}` and the updated configuration is `{"c":"d"}`, the final configuration in merge mode is `{"a":"b","c":"d"}`.
replace: the replace mode. If the original service configuration JSON is
`{"a":"b"}` and the updated configuration is `{"c":"d"}`, the final configuration in replace mode is `{"c":"d"}`
parameters.help_zh:
服务更新类型，目前支持合并模式和替换模式。不传默认为合并模式。

merge（合并模式）：若原服务配置JSON为
`{"a":"b"}`，更新配置为`{"c":"d"}` ，则合并模式下最终配置为`{"a":"b","c":"d"}`。
replace（替换模式）：若原服务配置JSON为
`{"a":"b"}`，更新配置为`{"c":"d"}` ，则替换模式下最终配置为`{"c":"d"}`
parameters.name: update_type

parameters.help_en: The type of the child service to update. Note: This parameter takes effect only for aggregated services
parameters.help_zh: 更新的子服务类型。注意：只在聚合服务中生效
parameters.name: member_to_update

parameters.help_en: The updated configuration. For more information about parameter settings, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/412086.html
parameters.help_zh: 更新配置。参数配置说明，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/412086.html
parameters.name: body

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to only precheck the request.

true: sends a precheck request without performing the actual operation. If the precheck fails, the corresponding error is returned. If the precheck succeeds, the error code DryRunOperation is returned.

false: sends a normal request. This is the default value
parameters.help_zh:
是否只预检此次请求。

true：发送检查请求，不会真正执行操作。如果检查不通过，则返回对应错误。如果检查通过，则返回错误码 DryRunOperation。

false（默认）：发送正常请求
parameters.name: dry_run

parameters.help_en: The client token used to ensure the idempotence of the request
parameters.help_zh: 用于保证请求的幂等性
parameters.name: client_token

Message.example: Succeed to update service [foo] in region [cn-shanghai]
